# Daily OK — Senior Check-In App

> Daily OK is a senior check-in app. An adult child sets up a once-a-day "I'm OK"
> for an aging parent, who taps one large button (or replies straight from the
> notification). If the parent misses the check-in, Daily OK fires escalating alerts
> to a chosen circle of family members. No pendant, no GPS tracking, no cameras, no
> wearables — presence without surveillance. The same gentle daily check-in also
> works for teens and any loved one you worry about. Plans run $3.99–$9.99 per month
> with a free trial. Available on iOS and Android.

## Core pages (senior check-in)
- [Daily OK — home / how it works](https://dailyok.net/): What the senior check-in app is, the one-tap "I'm OK" flow, escalation, and who it is for.
- [Check-in app for elderly](https://dailyok.net/check-in-app-for-elderly): What a daily check-in app for the elderly is and how it compares to pendants, trackers, and phone calls.
- [Daily check-in app for seniors](https://dailyok.net/daily-check-in-app-for-seniors): How a check-in app supports aging in place and where it fits vs monitored care.
- [Peace-of-mind app for elderly parents](https://dailyok.net/peace-of-mind-app-for-elderly-parents): The adult-child perspective — reducing caregiver worry without surveillance.
- [Elderly care use case](https://dailyok.net/elderly-care): Using Daily OK to check in on an aging parent living alone, including dementia-progression pattern alerts.
- [Pricing](https://dailyok.net/pricing): Caregiver ($3.99/mo), Family ($6.99/mo) and Family+ ($9.99/mo, Critical Alerts) plans, all with a 7-day free trial.
- [Support](https://dailyok.net/support): Help, contact, and common setup questions.

## Secondary use cases
- [Child & teen safety use case](https://dailyok.net/child-safety): The same consent-based daily check-in for children and teens, without continuous location tracking.

## Comparisons
- [Daily OK vs Life Alert](https://dailyok.net/compare/daily-ok-vs-life-alert): Daily check-in app vs medical-alert pendant — cost, hardware, escalation.
- [Daily OK vs Life360](https://dailyok.net/compare/daily-ok-vs-life360): Consent-based daily check-in vs continuous family location tracking.
- [Daily OK vs Snug Safety](https://dailyok.net/compare/daily-ok-vs-snug-safety): Two daily check-in apps compared on escalation, pricing, and privacy.
- [All comparisons](https://dailyok.net/compare): Index of Daily OK vs competitor breakdowns.
